# gating_allowlist.txt — basenames exempt from gating_sweep.sh's
# internal-audience denylist check.
#
# Add a line per HTML basename (e.g. "ops.html") ONLY when you have
# confirmed the page is genuinely public content that happens to share a
# denylisted name (see gating_sweep.sh DENY_REGEX) — not when a page is
# actually internal but inconvenient to gate. Every entry should be able to
# answer: "why is this safe to ship with no auth gate?"
#
# Empty as of 2026-07-14 — asaptic-web currently has no page whose basename
# collides with the denylist (its agents.html is a public marketing page and
# does not match the pattern, which only denies "agents-workbench.html").
